content:
The 3rd Round Allotment Result for Bihar CET B.Ed 2026 has been published on 23 July 2026.

Shortlisted candidates must:

  • Download the allotment letter online
  • Pay the ₹3,000 seat confirmation fee
  • Complete admission formalities at the allotted college within the given dates

Official portal: biharcetbed-brabu.in. Candidates who miss the confirmation deadline may lose the allotted seat.
